usage.callShape: GET https://api.crushrewards.dev/v1/marketing/brand-tracker?brand=Apple&country=us (params in query string, NOT JSON body)
usage.outputShape: body.time_series[] (array of {date, avg_price, min_price, max_price, product_count, in_stock_count, promo_count}); plus body.brand, body.country, body.currency
quirks: This is a GET endpoint: pass all inputs as URL query string params, NOT a JSON request body. The inputSchema lists a requestBody object but it maps to query params.
brand is required (e.g. brand=Apple). Optional: country (us|ca, default us), from and to (ISO 8601 dates, default last 30 days).
Pays via x402 on Base USDC; no API key / no SIWX needed.
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.crushrewards.dev/v1/marketing/brand-tracker with query params: required brand (e.g. brand=Sony), optional country=us|ca, from=YYYY-MM-DD, to=YYYY-MM-DD. Pay $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. The response is plain sync JSON: read the daily price/availability time-series from body.time_series[] (each item has date, avg_price, min_price, max_price, product_count, in_stock_count, promo_count), with body.brand/country/currency as context.
